    my_pos = observation.get('agent', {}).get('position', None)
    if my_pos is None:
        # No position info, default to no move
        return [0, 0]
    my_x, my_y = my_pos

    # Initialize move to stay in place
    dx, dy = 0, 0

    # Check for resource collection settings
    resources = observation.get('resources', [])
    if resources:
        # Find closest resource
        closest_resource = min(resources, key=lambda r: abs(r.get('x',0)-my_x)+abs(r.get('y',0)-my_y))
        res_x, res_y = closest_resource.get('x', my_x), closest_resource.get('y', my_y)
        delta_x = res_x - my_x
        delta_y = res_y - my_y
        # Move in the direction of resource if not already at position
        dx = (delta_x > 0) - (delta_x < 0)
        dy = (delta_y > 0) - (delta_y < 0)
        return [dx, dy]

    # Check for opponents to pursue (pursuit-evasion)
    opponents = observation.get('opponents', [])
    if opponents:
        # Find nearest opponent
        closest_opponent = min(opponents, key=lambda o: abs(o.get('x',0)-my_x)+abs(o.get('y',0)-my_y))
        opp_x, opp_y = closest_opponent.get('x', my_x), closest_opponent.get('y', my_y)
        delta_x = opp_x - my_x
        delta_y = opp_y - my_y
        # Move towards opponent
        dx = (delta_x > 0) - (delta_x < 0)
        dy = (delta_y > 0) - (delta_y < 0)
        return [dx, dy]

    # Territory control or default behavior
    territory = observation.get('territory', [])
    if territory:
        # Move towards the center of territory - assume center is average position
        xs = [t.get('x', my_x) for t in territory]
        ys = [t.get('y', my_y) for t in territory]
        center_x = sum(xs) / len(xs)
        center_y = sum(ys) / len(ys)
        delta_x = center_x - my_x
        delta_y = center_y - my_y
        # Decide move towards center
        dx = (delta_x > 0) - (delta_x < 0)
        dy = (delta_y > 0) - (delta_y < 0)
        return [dx, dy]

    # Default to no move
    return [0, 0]
